image_query: Kumbh Mela Sangam Prayagraj aerial view pilgrims
tweets: The Kumbh Mela gathers at Prayāga's Saṅgam, where Gaṅgā and Yamunā meet the unseen Sarasvatī — the largest congregation of people on Earth. The 2013 Mahā Kumbh drew over 100 million pilgrims in 55 days, its vast tent-city bright enough to be traced from orbit.

Held in rotation every twelve years at four sites — Prayāgraj, Haridwār, Ujjain and Nāsik — timed to Jupiter's position in the zodiac. UNESCO inscribed it as Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity in 2017. Follow @yddoseOfHistory for your daily dose of history
